CORE MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 36
   C. 7
   D. 6

2. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 12x
   C. 6x
   D. 6x + 2

3. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 1000 m²
   B. 10 000 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 100 m²

4. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 27.6
   C. 33
   D. 27.7

5. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 1/2
   C. 1/4
   D. Cannot tell

6. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 43

7. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 25
   C. 2
   D. 1

8. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 49

9. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 37

10. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31.6
   C. 31
   D. 31.7

11. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.7
   B. 15
   C. 15.6
   D. 21

12. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 55
   B. 32
   C. 22
   D. 16

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

3. B — 10 000 m²

5. B — 1/2

6. A — 1

7. A — 1

8. B — 1

9. B — 1

10. B — 31.6

11. C — 15.6

12. B — 32
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Perimeter = 2(L + W)
2. Substitute values: P = 2(11 + 5)
3. P = 2(16)
4. P = 32
Final Answer: 32 cm
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark
